annotations.text:
The pilot page, settled per Chris: foot key, ship-page section styling on the career (a rule edge to edge, the label under it), no status line under the name, and the copy as given. The line over the key reads Keep your points and log in on other devices; the banner reads You are using a guest account. Press here to set your password.

Still standing from earlier rounds: the reroll behind NEW NAME, career as bare totals (rating, tier, record and games are one meta call; rivets is on the client), the banner only once a guest has something to lose, on every tab but pilot, and the gold dot on the pilot stop either way. Signed in, the foot key goes and the page carries change password and log out; the one line kept there is signed in, easy to cut if it reads as noise.

Open questions before build: does the banner also stand over the arena HUD or only in the drawer; and does sign up ask for the password twice or once (once, plus log out asking for confirmation, is the lean answer).
